criteria.description: Light-mode code blocks use high-contrast text on the code background.
Artifact detail title/back navigation are stacked and artifact IDs wrap within the page.
Artifact overview cards use consistent value typography and long values are clipped or wrapped safely.
Artifact version does not duplicate artifact name and uses a file/version icon instead of the unknown icon.
Artifact refresh can load the artifact detail from the artifact REST read model if the in-memory projection is empty.
SBOM tab renders supported artifact-projection SBOM data and does not call unsupported SBOM detail endpoints.
Signature verification button says Verify and raw ContextVM/method-not-found errors are converted to user-facing wording.
High-visibility auth and DNS copy avoids protocol numbers and ContextVM transport wording.
Artifact registry list columns render the relay-backed projection shape without shifting version or digest values into the wrong columns.
